name: Shou
source:
She is a shikigami of the water activated by the blue paper. As a pioneer, she is good at disturbing the enemy's eyes, but her striking power is not decisive. Also, the defense is weak.
She has a short tempered and aggressive personality and has a rough language. A type in which the hand comes out before the mouth. Although she calls the summoner the Lord, she has no respect for him. However, the roots are very good just because they are clumsy. She has a somewhat anachronic way of thinking that he can overcome any difficulties with his guts.

[From Getchu]
